name: Barbell Reverse-Grip Close-Grip Bench Press
steps: Lie flat on a bench with feet planted firmly and take a shoulder-width underhand grip on the barbell with thumbs wrapped securely.
Draw your shoulder blades against the bench, brace and bring the bar above your shoulders.
Lower the bar slowly to your lower chest while keeping your elbows tucked tight beside your ribs.
Press the bar smoothly back up until your elbows extend fully, then rerack carefully.
tips: Keep both thumbs wrapped securely around the bar and your forearms stacked beneath it.
Use a controlled weight because the narrow underhand grip demands strong wrist stability.
